x: He beat Grice, Mouat, Stock and Buchanan in good time. JOHN is all set for an even better track season than 1967, when he recorded 8:57.6 for 3,000 metres steeplechase.

In the 5000m Laurie O'Hara sat in on Buchanan of Hillingdon until the final 80 metres when he leapt to the fore with his customary burst but surprise, surprise, the Hillingdon runner had more in hand and with a grin regained the lead, leaving Laurie with 2nd.
Both gave of their best but failed to hold the much more experienced Brighton pair of O'Shea and Buchanan who finished 2nd and 3rd. Our pair, with times of 11:01 and 12:31, finished 5th and 10th.
